subject: UTC bridge: proposed three-window demo schedule and next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Rose Chen <rose@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Sep 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: UTC bridge: proposed three-window demo schedule and next steps

Hi Rose —

Great to meet today; thanks for walking through Atlas Health's current inference needs and the high-level compliance constraints. Quick recap and a simple ask so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

Summary from discovery:
- Primary workload: batch clinical note summarization + on-demand query across patient records.
- Latency SLOs: 150–300ms p50 for small queries; bigger batch jobs ok for higher throughput.
- Security: SOC2 required, customer-managed keys preferred.
- Key stakeholders: you (platform), DevOps (cc), and Dr. Malik (data lead — will join if technical deep dive goes deep).

Next step ask: schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep dive with our infra/serving lead (Ben) + solutions (Monica). Because you have teams across US/EU/APAC we propose a light rotating cadence that puts the meeting within reasonable hours for at least one Atlas region each week.

Proposal (attached spreadsheet shows options):
- Three-window rotation (each week picks one time window) — windows are framed in UTC to avoid TZ confusion:
  1) Morning US window (UTC 14:00–15:30) — usually OK for West/East US and late EU attendees.
  2) Late EU / early APAC window (UTC 08:00–09:30) — good for EU mornings and APAC evenings.
  3) APAC-first window (UTC 00:00–01:30) — favors APAC, still workable for a small US night shift.

- Suggested cadence: run the three-window rotation for 6 weeks, then evaluate (short survey + quality check).
- Who should attend: platform owner + lead DevOps engineer + one data lead (optional).

Can you confirm the following by EOD Thursday?
1) Which window(s) work best for your org (pick A/B/C from above).
2) Any hard blackout days for the next 3 weeks.
3) Are you able to share Dr. Malik's availability if they will attend?

I attached a simple availability matrix (filled from our side) and a provisional .ics with the three candidate slots for next week so you can glance at calendar fit. If you prefer, tell me two concrete local times and we’ll map them to UTC windows.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this.

—
Soojín Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

Thanks, Soojin — nice summary. Quick answers here:

- Our preference: Window 2 (Late EU / early APAC) is the easiest for our EU team and still ok for APAC (they’re used to early evening calls). Window 1 also works on an as-needed basis. Window 3 is tough for most of our EU leads.
- Blackouts: next Wednesday (30 Sep) we have a scheduled maintenance window — avoid that day.
- Attendees: I’ll confirm Dr. Malik’s availability by Tuesday morning. For the deep dive we’ll have DevOps (I’ve cc’d them) plus a backend engineer (Tanya) — she’ll be the main hands-on person.

Could you propose two concrete dates in Window 2 next week? Late EU / early APAC in UTC would be ideal (your spreadsheet helped).

—
Rose Chen
Platform Lead | Atlas Health
rose@atlashealth.com | +44 20 7946 0123

Option A: Tue, 2025-09-30 at 08:00 UTC (60–75m)
Option B: Thu, 2025-10-02 at 09:00 UTC (60–75m)

I’ll lead the serving/runtime section and Monica will cover integration patterns (prefix caching, routing policies, and quantization tradeoffs).

If either works I’ll drop a provisional calendar invite (Zoom link + shared doc) and attach a short pre-read (one-pager) to help Tanya and your DevOps team prepare.
